descriptions: Firm ground gives out here. Beyond, the bog stretches away, brown and black, with paths of laid planks that disappear into the mist.
features: A cairn of stones with a broken spade on top.

descriptions: Neat black walls of cut peat stand drying in stacks, the trench below full of brown water.
An old peat cutting, its edges slumped, half drowned.
features: A peat spade, its handle worn pale.
ambient: A clod of peat slides into the water.

descriptions: A track of old planks laid across the bog. Some of them are missing.
The duckboards sink a little under each step, and water wells up between them.
ambient: Bubbles rise somewhere to your left.

descriptions: A round pool of water so dark it looks like a hole in the world.
A pool ringed with cotton grass, its water the colour of strong tea.
features: A leather shoe floating in the middle, very old.
ambient: Something moves under the surface, and then doesn't.

descriptions: A low island of heather and birch, the only dry ground for a long way.
A hummock of moss, springy underfoot, with a twisted birch on top.
features: Bones of a sheep, picked clean, among the heather.
ambient: A curlew calls, long and falling.

descriptions: The ground here quakes like a pudding. Every step sinks to the ankle.
A soft green hollow where the moss grows too bright. You know better than to stand still.
